title: Probatorium time-series sidecar
description: timeseries/1 schema for the decompressed timeseries.json.gz sidecar (probatorium#153). Separate from results.json (schema_v5.json): per (scenario, server) it keeps each run's raw 1 Hz series PLUS a cross-run min/p50/p99/max/mean band over per-elapsed-second RPS, windowed P99 latency and per-window error delta. The band is a small-sample envelope over per-bucket values, NOT an HDR-merged latency percentile. loadgen (>= v1.4.5) feeds p99_ms and errors on every tick, so the p99_ms and errors bands are always present alongside rps.

schema_version.description: Sidecar schema tag, versioned independently of results.json.

rps.description: Instantaneous request rate over the prior 1-second bucket.

p99_ms.description: Per-bucket windowed P99 latency (ms). Fed by loadgen (>= v1.4.5); omitted only when a measured 0.

errors.description: Per-bucket error delta over the prior 1-second window. Fed by loadgen (>= v1.4.5); omitted only when a measured 0.

rps.description: Cross-run band over per-bucket RPS. Always present.

p99_ms.description: Cross-run band over per-bucket windowed P99 latency (ms). Present for every bucket with a contributing point (loadgen >= v1.4.5).

errors.description: Cross-run band over per-bucket error deltas. Present for every bucket with a contributing point (loadgen >= v1.4.5).
